en.title: Why an outbox
en.excerpt: Saving a row and publishing an event are two writes; the outbox makes them one.
en.body:
## The problem

A service saves a row and must publish an event for it.

:::callout
Both go in **one** transaction.
:::

See the [relay](https://example.com/relay) or [this link](javascript:alert(1)).
